truth_basis: sealed shopmall source slices listed in semantic-sample-20.json
pre-existing shopmall quality-expectations.json for structural CALL/RW/control only
scope_note: These judgments cover only the 20 sealed functions and listed behavior cases; they do not generalize to all 1609 RULE rows.

cases.expect: null out_order_id or non-positive member_id returns RET_INVALID; a non-null output is initialized to 0
authentication failure maps RET_LIMIT to RET_LIMIT, RET_DENIED to RET_DENIED, other failures to RET_FAIL; a second daily-count check blocks count above DAILY_AUTH_LIMIT
empty/invalid cart or failed/insufficient representative stock prevents checkout before order creation
non-positive cart total, invalid representative price, failed limit validation, or non-positive recalculated amount aborts with the source-specific code
orders is inserted in receive state, then stock is reserved and order items are created; failures call rollback_order with the corresponding reason
negative shipping fee falls back to BASE_SHIP_FEE; grade policy Y or order amount at least FREE_SHIP_AMOUNT makes it zero; otherwise a delegated zero is forced back to the base fee
usable points are capped at pay_amount and ignored below MIN_USE_POINT; failed point_use becomes non-fatal no-use; pay_amount is never left negative
VIP uses easy payment and others card; payment failure rolls back and marks the order error; paid-state update failure calls payment_cancel then rolls back
missing address or shipping failure leaves a paid order for later handling; successful shipping advances the order to ready
cart_clear failure falls back to direct DELETE; commit failure rolls back and fails; point earning after commit is non-fatal; success sets out_order_id and returns RET_OK
invalid member_id or auth_type outside 1,2,3 sets AUTH_RSLT_MISS when possible and returns RET_INVALID
missing member returns RET_NOT_FOUND, load error RET_FAIL, withdrawn member RET_DENIED after recording a try, daily limit sets AUTH_RSLT_OVER and returns RET_LIMIT
mobile auth requires stored/decryptable non-empty mobile; SMS send failure is explicitly non-fatal
email auth succeeds only for a non-empty address containing @
simple auth treats nested_depth above 3 as expired and a negative dispatch token result as mismatch
only successful mobile auth attempts the member last-login UPDATE
authentication history is attempted for every final result and history failure does not change that result
AUTH_RSLT_OK returns RET_OK, MISS/EXPIRE return RET_FAIL, OVER returns RET_LIMIT, and result_code_out receives the final code when non-null
invalid order, non-positive amount, or null approval output returns RET_INVALID
missing order returns RET_NOT_FOUND; only receive-state orders proceed; paid is RET_DUP, cancelled/other states RET_DENIED, and amount mismatch RET_INVALID
amount above PAY_REAUTH_AMOUNT requires member reauthentication and failure returns RET_DENIED
card/easy paths fall back to the literal test card when lookup fails; point-only checks balance and point_use, but the sealed code still falls through to the later common PG path
missing PG configuration fails; PG-forced reauth is honored; PG limit maps to RET_LIMIT and other approval failures record failure history then RET_FAIL
virtual-account success records payment, returns the approval number, commits, and does not update paid order/settlement/points in this call
normal success requires payment record and paid-order update; settlement and point-earn failures are warnings and do not revoke payment success
success-history failure is non-fatal, approval output is set, but commit failure rolls back and returns RET_FAIL
invalid order/address/required address fields, delivery-company selection failure, or mobile/address encryption failure aborts before shipping persistence
missing shipping row is inserted with a new sequence; an existing shipped row returns RET_DUP; an existing unshipped row reuses its sequence and is updated
initial trace failure is non-fatal; courier failure adds a return trace, rolls back, and returns RET_FAIL
missing invoice uses TMP plus shipping_seq; invoice encryption failure stores an empty encrypted value, while invoice UPDATE failure is fatal
gather/trunk/out traces are created; stock deduction and order-shipping update are both fatal on failure
SMS failure is non-fatal; commit failure rolls back and fails
channel Q additionally marks done and dispatches review_point notify; notify failure is non-fatal; function returns RET_OK
discount_out is zeroed when present; validation failure is returned unchanged after a best-effort failure-history insert
missing order returns RET_NOT_FOUND, query error RET_FAIL, and failed grade lookup falls back to G0
VIP-only policy N denies; absent policy permits only G4/G5; policy query error logs and proceeds
zero discount without free-shipping returns RET_DENIED for DENY/GRADE last errors and RET_INVALID otherwise
negative orders update fails and zero affected rows is treated as a concurrent RET_DUP
recalc dispatch failure and promo-point failure are non-fatal after coupon persistence; undocumented/event coupons attempt promo points
success writes disc to discount_out when present and returns RET_OK
member/order/product validity and rating range 1..5 are mandatory
not-purchased returns RET_DENIED, missing order/item RET_NOT_FOUND, and other purchase-check error RET_FAIL
duplicate-check query error fails and an existing same member/order/product review returns RET_DUP
missing product name does not block registration; rating <=2 maps content flag 07, rating 3 maps 03, and ratings 4..5 map 05
sequence or review insert failure returns RET_FAIL; a successful insert establishes a positive review_id
rating update failure and review point earning failure are non-fatal; earning uses buy_amount/10 only when buy_amount is positive
commit failure rolls back and returns RET_FAIL; otherwise the positive review_id is returned
empty warehouse means all warehouses; a non-empty invalid warehouse returns RET_INVALID
no stock rows is a successful empty run; opening-query failure returns RET_FAIL
real_qty defaults to book avail_qty; successful count dispatch with positive hold subtracts hold_qty/SAFE_MARGIN and floors at zero; dispatch failure leaves no difference
RET_OK difference does nothing, RET_DUP auto-adjusts without audit, RET_LIMIT audits and auto-adjusts, RET_DENIED audits for manual review without adjustment, other results increment errors
the million-row cap breaks the loop; a negative fetch result is counted as an error after partial processing
any accumulated error returns RET_FAIL; hard manual-review differences alone still return RET_OK
settle_dt must be non-empty and LEN_DATE; load failure rolls back and fails, while no targets returns RET_OK
invalid order ids, missing payments, non-target results, and non-positive amounts are skipped; payment query errors increment errors
positive point use plus positive pay amount classifies MIX; due to the earlier non-positive guard the POINT branch is unreachable in this function; otherwise CARD
negative settlement amount is floored to zero; upsert OK increments ok and pending, DUP skips, other failure increments errors
interim commits occur at STL_BATCH_UNIT and remaining pending work is committed after the loop
the sealed function returns RET_OK even when err_cnt is positive, explicitly treating errors as partial success
flag_out is initialized to zero; empty coupon or non-positive order id returns RET_INVALID
missing order returns RET_NOT_FOUND, query error RET_FAIL, and any existing coupon including the same coupon returns RET_DUP
cancelled, error, or done orders are denied; shipping state logs but continues
VIP15 sets VIP-only, free-ship sets free-shipping, XMAS/EVT0722 set undocumented; unknown code is accepted only when get_code_name supplies a non-empty name, then marked undocumented
any non-OK period check returns RET_DENIED; success publishes flags and returns RET_OK
invalid order returns RET_INVALID, missing payment RET_NOT_FOUND, and payment query error RET_FAIL
done proceeds, already-cancelled returns RET_DUP, wait skips PG later, partial proceeds with warning, and unknown status returns RET_DENIED
non-wait payments require successful PG communication and a non-denied response; failures return RET_FAIL
payment and orders cancellation updates are mandatory and roll back on failure
settlement cancellation uses negative paid_amount when a sequence exists; sequence or insert failure is non-fatal
earned points are clawed back through negative history and member balance subtraction when sequences permit; failures are warnings
cancellation history is best-effort; commit failure rolls back and fails, otherwise RET_OK
invalid member/product/qty returns RET_INVALID and request qty above MAX_CART_ITEM returns RET_LIMIT
non-displayable or display lookup failure returns RET_DENIED
missing stock row or insufficient avail-hold returns RET_LIMIT; query error RET_FAIL; negative avail/hold are normalized to zero
line-count failure returns RET_FAIL; at the line limit only a genuinely new product line is rejected
successful upsert requires successful commit; duplicate/other upsert failures roll back and return RET_FAIL; only the successful path returns RET_OK
member, point type, and positive amount are required; EARN/REVERT add and USE/EXPIRE subtract; unknown type is invalid
missing member returns RET_NOT_FOUND and member-query error RET_FAIL
withdrawn members cannot earn/revert but may use/expire for balance cleanup
subtracting more than current balance returns RET_DENIED; otherwise new_balance equals current minus or plus amount
history sequence and insert must succeed with a positive affected count
member balance update must affect a row; success records the exact new balance and returns RET_OK
outputs are initialized; negative and under 100000 map G1, then thresholds 500000/G2, 1000000/G3, 3000000/G4, otherwise G5
hardcoded rates are G1 0.5, G2 1, G3 2, G4 3, G5 5
a successful positive policy rate overrides the hardcoded rate; non-positive, not-found, or query error preserves it
non-null outputs receive final grade/rate and the function always returns RET_OK
empty states are invalid, same state is idempotently OK, DONE/RETURN current states are terminal and denied, and next RETURN is otherwise allowed
RECV to GATHER is normal; RECV to OUT is allowed only on channel Q; other RECV transitions are invalid
only GATHER->TRUNK, TRUNK->OUT, and OUT->DONE are normal
unknown current state is audited and returns RET_INVALID
invalid member or row-load failure returns RET_FAIL; zero selected rows returns zero
vanished row ends the loop; query error fails; non-selected, empty product, or non-positive qty rows are skipped
catalog price is preferred; non-positive catalog price falls back to PRODUCT; missing product skips, query error fails, and negative DB price is floored to zero
line amount is qty times unit price, negative line amount is floored to zero, and total accumulates and is returned
output count is initialized; invalid ids return RET_INVALID; no cart returns RET_NOT_FOUND; query error RET_FAIL; cart count is truncated to MAX_ORDER_ITEM
individual cart fetch failures, empty product, non-positive qty, or non-positive price skip that row rather than failing all
sequence failure or order_item insert failure aborts with RET_FAIL; each success increments made
zero created items returns RET_FAIL; otherwise item_cnt_out receives made and RET_OK is returned
logs COMMIT and unconditionally returns RET_OK; it has no domain read/write semantics
null or empty input returns without mutation
trailing spaces, tabs, newline, and carriage return are removed
leading spaces and tabs are removed by shifting the remaining string; internal whitespace is preserved
null output returns RET_INVALID; empty current state sets RECV and returns RET_OK
RECV->GATHER, GATHER->TRUNK, TRUNK->OUT, and OUT->DONE
DONE and RETURN have no next state and return RET_NOT_FOUND; unknown state returns RET_INVALID
empty grade immediately returns EARN_RATE_G1; non-empty grade performs a code-name lookup
G1/G2/G3/G4/G5 map respectively to EARN_RATE_G1/G2/G3/G4/G5
unknown grade audits and falls back to EARN_RATE_G1
